title: Design refresh: build and behavior checks passed
summary: The updated academy passes TypeScript, focused lint, web export and ten history/navigation tests. Browser and native visual checks remain outstanding.

changes.detail: Verified the dashboard, design tokens, shared page styles and navigation changes described in the linked implementation report.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit completed with exit code 0.

validation.name: Focused ESLint
validation.detail: All four changed application files passed ESLint.

validation.name: Change history
validation.detail: Six tests passed: expansion/collapse, status/details, preview/history routing, retry, persistence, archive conflicts and immutable append behavior. Manifest check passed.

validation.name: Learning navigation
validation.detail: Four tests passed for course search/filter recovery/next lesson, More destinations and languages, and teacher context navigation.

validation.name: Web export
validation.detail: Expo web export completed successfully to artifacts/design-refresh-web.

validation.name: Visual and device QA
